nodes.label: ROUTEMAP.md — module index
nodes.rationale: Compact codebase map so a fresh chat loads only the files a task needs instead of scanning src/; per-module line counts flag context cost.

nodes.label: Task → files table
nodes.rationale: Maps each task area (schema, scoring, active workout, past workouts, equipment, diet UI, food DBs, AI, sync, charts, settings) to the minimal set of files to load.

nodes.label: ROUTEMAP maintenance rule (one line per module)
nodes.rationale: Adding, renaming or removing a module, or changing an invariant, must update the matching one-line row and the Task → files table in the same change so the index stays trustworthy; a subsystem past ~8 files gets its own section.

nodes.label: Static PWA on GitHub Pages (no backend)
nodes.rationale: With no server, cross-device sync is a snapshot pushed to a private GitHub repo with the user's PAT, AI is Gemini free tier with a device-local bring-your-own key, and only free CORS-open food APIs without secret keys are usable. Stack: React + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind, Dexie/IndexedDB, HashRouter.

nodes.label: GitHub snapshot sync (private repo via PAT)
nodes.rationale: Cross-device sync without a backend: buildPayload serializes only the TABLES allow-list, installSyncTriggers pushes dirty state on an 8s debounce, and merge.ts merges local and remote snapshots row by row (updatedAt wins, foods dedup by offId).

nodes.label: AI layer (Gemini free tier, device-local BYO key)
nodes.rationale: Shared Gemini client built around the generateStructured engine, aiStore holding key/model in localStorage, the generic AiReportCard state machine (3-state cache, auto/manual generate, offline/no-key/error, regenerate) and the Settings key + model picker.

nodes.label: AI workout coach + opening-weight suggestions
nodes.rationale: Post-workout coach note is auto-generated and cached by sessionId; pre-workout AI opening weights fire once per session, are cached and fall back silently offline (suggestNext double progression is the offline baseline).

nodes.label: AI diet coach + macro-completion / food-swap
nodes.rationale: Diet report is generated manually and cached by date; 'complete your macros' suggestions offer tap-to-Add; EntryEditor offers an AI 'Suggest a swap'; AI food suggestions resolve to real foods (known → OFF/USDA macro-matched → custom).

nodes.label: App shell & routing
nodes.rationale: App.tsx owns the HashRouter and all routes and, on launch, runs ensureSeeded, runDailyChecks, catch-up achievements/quests, installs sync triggers and performs a first sync.

nodes.label: Data model & persistence
nodes.rationale: types.ts holds every interface (Id = number|string); Dexie GymDB (version 7) adds a sync middleware that assigns UUID ids, stamps updatedAt and sets a dirty flag.

nodes.label: Workout subsystem
Diet & nutrition subsystem
nodes.rationale: nutrition.ts logFood is the single write path for food logs.

nodes.label: Gamification & progress modules
nodes.rationale: Achievements and weekly quests are add-only: they are awarded but never revoked.

nodes.label: Vitest unit-test suite (~158 tests)
nodes.rationale: Tests sit next to their lib, run in vitest's node environment without jsdom and cover pure functions only.

nodes.label: ROUTEMAP Invariants (cross-cutting rules)
nodes.rationale: Must be read before any schema, sync, scoring or AI change.

nodes.label: Invariant 1: backup.ts TABLES is the sync allow-list
nodes.rationale: A table syncs iff it is listed in TABLES (mirrored in merge.ts SnapshotTables), the single source of truth for what serializes. Device-local AI caches (coachNotes, dietNotes, workoutSuggestions, dietSuggestions) are deliberately excluded and must never be added.

nodes.label: Invariant 2: AI cache writes use withSyncTrackingSuspended
nodes.rationale: AI cache rows use natural keys (not in UUID_TABLES) and must not mark data dirty for sync; real user-data writes (sessions, sets, foods, rank) must NOT be suspended so they still sync.

nodes.label: Invariant 3: Gemini API key never touches Dexie
nodes.rationale: The key lives only in the aiStore Zustand store persisted to localStorage (gymtracker-ai), which keeps the secret out of the Dexie tables that back up and sync.

nodes.label: Invariant 4: thinkingBudget=0 on every structured Gemini call
nodes.rationale: Gemini Flash otherwise truncates the JSON output; new generators must be added via generateStructured<T>, which sets generationConfig.thinkingConfig.thinkingBudget=0.

nodes.label: Invariant 5: finishSession is non-idempotent — re-score with rescoreSession
nodes.rationale: finishSession adds a scoreEvent, adds full points and bumps the streak, so re-running it on an edit duplicates all three. rescoreSession updates the existing event, applies only the points delta and carries the streak.

nodes.label: Invariant 6: equipment separation is by exerciseId
nodes.rationale: Variants are distinct exercises and there is no SetRow.equipment; every weight/PR/progression path already partitions by exerciseId.

nodes.label: Invariant 7: food dedup key offId = barcode ?? source:sourceId
nodes.rationale: Reuses the existing &offId unique index and merge.ts dedup, so no schema migration is needed and OFF rows stay backward-compatible (bare EAN); USDA branded foods reuse the EAN and whole foods become usda:<fdcId>.

nodes.label: Invariant 8: additive Dexie schema + deterministic seed ids
nodes.rationale: Bump version(N) with only new stores and never edit a released version block (GymDB is at version 7). Seed rows use id i+1 so two fresh installs merge without duplicating the exercise catalog.

nodes.label: Invariant 9: propagating deletes use tombstones
nodes.rationale: Deletes that must reach other devices go through deleteWithTombstone/tombstoneKeys; device-local cache deletes use a plain suspended delete().

nodes.label: Invariant 10: HashRouter + parseRouteId; order by date, not id
nodes.rationale: Ids may be numbers or UUID strings, so route ids are parsed with parseRouteId (never Number()), and because UUID strings don't sort chronologically, queries use orderBy('date'/'startedAt') instead of orderBy('id').

nodes.label: Invariant 11: report mode (?report=1) skips side-effects
nodes.rationale: Viewing an old session must skip checkAchievements, evaluateQuests, confetti and rank-up, whose side-effects are wrong for past sessions.

nodes.label: Invariant 12: Env/CI rules (Node 18 floor / CI Node 22, workbox-build 7.1.1, no CDN)
nodes.rationale: Vite 5 / Tailwind 3.4 are pinned so Node 18 still works while CI builds on Node 22; workbox-build is overridden to 7.1.1; every asset is self-hosted (zxing wasm and fonts bundled, no CDN); the USDA key is inlined into the public bundle, which is acceptable only for a free per-IP-rate-limited key.

nodes.label: Build stamp (__APP_VERSION__, __BUILD_SHA__, __BUILD_TIME__)
nodes.rationale: vite.config.ts defines the app version from package.json, the build SHA from GITHUB_SHA (falling back to local git) and the build time; typed in src/vite-env.d.ts and shown by the Settings VersionFooter next to the Dexie schema version (db.verno).

nodes.label: Invariant 13: every screen fits 360px and 320px widths
nodes.rationale: Galaxy S25 is 360px wide: two+ NumberSteppers in one row use compact='narrow' + flex-wrap; chips, badges and short buttons get whitespace-nowrap (+ shrink-0 in flex rows) so they move as a unit; names truncate; fixed-px widths in a row must sum under ~290px.
